title: Rate Book Declining-Block Note — Pricing Over-Registered kWh on Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Note.** When a fast meter's over-registration on an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account is refunded, the over-registered energy is priced according to the shape of the schedule's energy rate. "The window" is the rebill window of the correction; "the window's kWh" are the kWh on the account's energy charge lines in the window; "the allowance" is the schedule's block 1 limit multiplied by the number of those energy charge lines; and "the over-registered kWh" are the window's kWh multiplied by the overbilled share, unrounded.

| Schedule | Block 1 limit (kWh per period) | Block 1 rate | Block 2 rate | Declining block |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Schedule R Residential Service | 1000 | $0.11840 | $0.10920 | Yes |
| Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service | 1000 | $0.12610 | $0.12610 | No |
| Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | 1500 | $0.11840 | $0.10420 | Yes |
| Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service | 2500 | $0.11275 | $0.10350 | Yes |
| Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service | 5000 | $0.10460 | $0.09715 | Yes |
| Schedule IR Irrigation Service | 20000 | $0.08915 | $0.08915 | No |
| Schedule LP Large Power Service | 200000 | $0.06380 | $0.05845 | Yes |

A schedule is declining block when its block 2 rate is below its block 1 rate.

| Schedule and usage | Energy refunded |
|---|---|
| Declining block, and the window's kWh exceed the allowance | The over-registered kWh multiplied by the block 2 rate — the marginal rate they were billed at — rounded to the cent |
| Declining block, and the window's kWh do not exceed the allowance | The over-registered kWh multiplied by the block 1 rate, rounded to the cent |
| Not declining block (Schedule RS, Schedule IR) | The overbilled share of the amounts of the window's energy charge lines, rounded to the cent |

### Hypothetical cases (overbilled share 4 divided by 104)

| Account | Window | Window's kWh | Allowance | Over-registered kWh | Energy refunded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Schedule R | 6 energy lines | 7800 | 6000 | 300 | 300 kWh at $0.10920, $32.76 |
| Schedule R | 6 energy lines | 5200 | 6000 | 200 | 200 kWh at $0.11840, $23.68 |
| Schedule R | 6 energy lines | 6000 | 6000 | about 230.77 | at $0.11840 — equal to the allowance is not above it — $27.32 |
| Schedule IR | energy lines totalling $2,400.00 | — | — | — | $2,400.00 multiplied by 4 and divided by 104, $92.31 |
